title: REALOG (RelAtional Learning On Graphs)
summary: A package for training graph neural networks to predict target values across relational multi-table datasets, using an SDV-style metadata format to define table relationships and demo datasets for testing. It subclasses SDV's MultiTableMetadata for its schema handling and uses sdv.datasets.demo to fetch example relational datasets, making the SDV metadata component load-bearing for its data pipeline.
